title: The Locked Well
description: A horrifying mystery unravels as a village girl hears voices from an old well—sealed since the night her sister disappeared.

scenes.visual_prompt: (split-style frame:1.2) left side dark forest with glowing eyes, right side glowing book opening with green mist, title words 'Why Would You?' forming in eerie light, cinematic horror style(1.3)
scenes.negative_prompt: cartoon, gore, extra limbs, bright colors, unrealistic
scenes.narration:
[mysterious] कभी आपने सोचा है... वो बातें... जो हमें डराती भी हैं और खींचती भी?
स्वागत है आपके अपने चैनल... Why Would You?
scenes.subtitle: Channel Intro

scenes.description: opening shot of a rural house under moonlight with an old sealed well
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot:1.2) rural Indian village at night(1.3), old brick well with heavy iron lid locked by rusted chains, full moon in background, fog rising from fields, haunted horror atmosphere(1.3), cinematic realistic lighting

scenes.narration:

और एक पुराना कुआँ... जिसकी साँकलें अब भी सिसकती हैं...
जहाँ एक रात... कोई लौटकर नहीं आया।
scenes.subtitle: Intro

scenes.description: Meera walking past the well and hearing her name
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) 19-year-old Indian village girl, long braid, wearing salwar kameez, stops beside old locked well at night, looking shocked, slight wind blowing, realistic horror style(1.3)
scenes.narration:

कुएँ के पास से गुज़रती मीरा ने सुना—
'मीरा...'
scenes.subtitle: First Whisper
scenes.motion_prompt: wind rustling leaves, faint whisper echo

scenes.description: Meera asks her mother about the well
scenes.visual_prompt: (medium shot:1.2) older Indian woman with tired eyes, oil lamp beside her, sitting in mud courtyard, worried look, Meera asking question, realistic lighting(1.3)
scenes.negative_prompt: cartoon, fantasy, extra limbs, overly dramatic, low resolution

'मौसी उस रात कहाँ गई थी?'
[mother serious] माँ की आँखों में उभरा वही डर...
‘उस कुएँ का नाम न लो... वो रात अशुभ थी बेटा... बहुत अशुभ।’

scenes.description: Meera peeks at night and sees the lock is open

लेकिन... उसे खोला किसने?

scenes.description: ghostly voice from the well calling out

वो आवाज़... पुरानी थी... लेकिन मीरा के दिल को चीरती हुई।

scenes.motion_prompt: fog swirling, echo from within the well
